messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-queue-growth detected in eu-west-1. Queue length for /v1/generate > 3k and growing, throttling downstream requests. autoscaler attempted scale but hit max_nodes for pool 'inference-eu-prod'.
SRE Oncall: Seeing 502s and backpressure alerts in the dashboard. Are pods stuck pending?
Chris M: Checking k8s: lots of Pending on nodeSelector gpu=true. Describe shows Pending due to nodeAffinity + max node limit. Cluster autoscaler logs: \"Reached max node count for nodegroup inference-eu-prod (50)\".
Anya B: Confirmed. Autoscaler retried 6 times, then backoff. Also seeing OOMKill on a few pods before they restarted.
SRE Oncall: Customer impact? Which customers affected?
Support Lead: Support dashboard shows elevated errors for a handful of high-throughput accounts (acct-842, acct-390). We're throttling at API layer but queues are piling. Ticket volume rising.
Chris M: Quick mitigation checklist: 1) Manual nodegroup cap raise? 2) Evict noncritical pods from GPU pool? 3) Route traffic to other regions/models? 4) Apply temporary rate-limit per-customer?
Anya B: 3) is limited — other regions at capacity for some model variants. 2) We can cordon non-inference nodes but many noncritical pods already scheduled elsewhere. 4) Support can apply soft limits to high-volume customers.
Kevin (Infra): Will need approval for manual cap raise — raising nodegroup to 70 will require quota check and estimated cost bump. I'm on it.
SRE Oncall: Chris, can you paste the autoscaler log snippet?
Chris M: Paste below:
```
I0321 14:20:03.123456 1 scale.go:243] NodeGroup inference-eu-prod: Desired: 50, Max: 50, CloudProvider: GKE
I0321 14:20:03.223456 1 scale.go:310] Not scaling up: reached maximum size for nodegroup inference-eu-prod (50)
I0321 14:25:10.987654 1 scale.go:456] Retrying scale up after backoff
```
SRE Oncall: Makes sense. We need manual override. Kevin, what ETA for approval/quota confirm?
Kevin (Infra): Quota check: GPU quota in account is 80 for eu-west-1. We already have 65 in use across other pools. If we raise nodegroup to 70 we'll cross into quota reallocation territory. Need cloud ops approval — pinging cloud-ops.
ops-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-20240321-01. Priority: P1. Paging oncall rotation.
Support Lead: I'm posting a customer advisory to affected accounts with suggested mitigation and ETA.
Anya B: While infra works approval, we can reduce per-request max_tokens and enable prefix caching for long-running jobs to reduce token churn. Patch ready: apply snippet below to route config:
```
routes:
  - path: /v1/generate
    policy:
      token_limit: 1024  # temporary from 4096
      enable_prefix_cache: true
```
SRE Oncall: Good. Chris, can you drain one node for quick reclaim and evict any misplaced daemonsets consuming GPUs?
Chris M: Running drain on node gpu-8a0f now. If pods are DaemonSets with tolerations they'll come back on other nodes unless we taint. Doing taint: 
```
kubectl taint nodes gpu-8a0f temporary=drain:NoSchedule
kubectl drain gpu-8a0f --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Anya B: Noted. Also enabling fallback model variant (cpu-light) for non-critical routes to reduce GPU load. Will push config in 2m.
Kevin (Infra): Cloud-ops approved temporary quota bump to 90 for 2 hours. Manual nodegroup max updated to 80. ETA for new nodes (warm startup) ~7-9 mins.
SRE Oncall: Proceed with manual bump. Chris, queue heavy requests should start draining once new nodes register. Keep monitoring pods Pending → Running.
Chris M: Executed manual bump. Watching node registration: new nodes appearing: gpu-9a1, gpu-9a2, gpu-9a3... kubelet reports ready. Rebalancing pods.
ops-bot: Event: nodes_added inference-eu-prod +3.
SRE Oncall: I'm seeing queue length drop from 3200 → 600 over 8 minutes. Error rate trending down. Support Lead, update customers: ETA for full recovery 15–20m from now.
Support Lead: Posted update to affected customers and created follow-up tickets for rate-limit exemptions where needed.
Anya B: Rolling back token_limit and cache toggles once stable. Also creating a post-incident action item: investigate pod sizing+bin packing to avoid single pool saturation and add predictive scale policy based on 95th percentile spike detection.
Chris M: Action items: 1) Add autoscaler metrics alert for remaining capacity < 15%. 2) Add preflight quota checks before scale. 3) Document manual bump runbook with exact cloud console and CLI steps.
Kevin (Infra): I'll schedule a quota review and pre-approved emergency bump policy for next oncall cycle.
SRE Oncall: Closing incident when queue < 50 and error rate baseline. Current: queue 42, errors normalizing. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT-20240321-01 resolved. Duration: 0h36m.
